units.rawText: Should I go in? Sako, they said Croque was my friend, but I don't even remember who she is...

units.rawText: Simo eventually finds his resolve. He pushes open the door gently, as though he doesn't want to disturb the memories sealed behind it.

units.rawText: Croque is lying on the other side of the quarantine barrier. Her eyes are shut tight and her brow is furrowed. Purplish-black veins coil around her neck, pulsing with faint light, as though they're breathing.

units.rawText: Simo unconsciously clenches his fists. Nameless anger and sadness well up inside him.
units.displayText: Simo unconsciously clenches his fists. Nameless anger and sadness well up inside him.

spans.text: Simo unconsciously clenches his fists. Nameless anger and sadness well up inside him.

units.displayText: Squeak-squeak, squeak-squeak.

units.displayText: Hm!? Sako, be quiet.

spans.text: Hm!? Sako, be quiet.

units.rawText: ...Who's that?
units.displayText: ...Who's that?

spans.text: ...Who's that?

units.displayText: Croque opens her eyes weakly.

units.rawText: You...
units.displayText: You...

spans.text: You...

units.rawText: You go first.
units.displayText: You go first.

units.rawText: Silence engulfs the room. The tongue-tied pair stare at each other awkwardly through the quarantine barrier.
units.displayText: Silence engulfs the room. The tongue-tied pair stare at each other awkwardly through the quarantine barrier.

units.rawText: ...Hello, I'm Simo.
units.displayText: ...Hello, I'm Simo.

spans.text: ...Hello, I'm Simo.

units.rawText: Huh? Ha... (Coughs).
units.displayText: Huh? Ha... (Coughs).

spans.text: Huh? Ha... (Coughs).

units.rawText: What a weird way to start a conversation. I know you, I'm Croque.
units.displayText: What a weird way to start a conversation. I know you, I'm Croque.

spans.text: What a weird way to start a conversation. I know you, I'm Croque.

units.rawText: ...I'm sorry, I don't know what to say at times like this.
units.displayText: ...I'm sorry, I don't know what to say at times like this.

spans.text: ...I'm sorry, I don't know what to say at times like this.

units.rawText: I'm very sorry I can't have a familiar chat with you like before.
units.displayText: I'm very sorry I can't have a familiar chat with you like before.

spans.text: I'm very sorry I can't have a familiar chat with you like before.

units.rawText: Well, we weren't actually that close before. This isn't actually that different from how we used to be. Even trying to keep up a conversation for several minutes was hard.
units.displayText: Well, we weren't actually that close before. This isn't actually that different from how we used to be. Even trying to keep up a conversation for several minutes was hard.

spans.text: Well, we weren't actually that close before. This isn't actually that different from how we used to be. Even trying to keep up a conversation for several minutes was hard.

units.rawText: I'm actually surprised you came to visit me.
units.displayText: I'm actually surprised you came to visit me.

spans.text: I'm actually surprised you came to visit me.

units.rawText: ...Did we not get along then? But the others told me... we were friends.
units.displayText: ...Did we not get along then? But the others told me... we were friends.

spans.text: ...Did we not get along then? But the others told me... we were friends.

units.rawText: Yes, we're friends. At least, I consider us friends.
units.displayText: Yes, we're friends. At least, I consider us friends.

spans.text: Yes, we're friends. At least, I consider us friends.

units.rawText: It's just that you've always been very distant from everyone.
units.displayText: It's just that you've always been very distant from everyone.

spans.text: It's just that you've always been very distant from everyone.

units.rawText: Simo flinches. He's just about to speak when a sudden alarm cuts him off.
units.displayText: Simo flinches. He's just about to speak when a sudden alarm cuts him off.

spans.text: Simo flinches. He's just about to speak when a sudden alarm cuts him off.

units.displayText: Screams and confusion suddenly fill the air outside the door.

spans.text: Screams and confusion suddenly fill the air outside the door.

units.displayText: Alert, subject in Medical Center Ward 3 has gone berserk.

units.displayText: Repeat, subject in Medical Center Ward 3 has gone berserk.

spans.text: Repeat, subject in Medical Center Ward 3 has gone berserk.

units.rawText: Simo's head jerks up, and through the quarantine barrier, he can see the walls of Croque's room trembling.
units.displayText: Simo's head jerks up, and through the quarantine barrier, he can see the walls of Croque's room trembling.

spans.text: Simo's head jerks up, and through the quarantine barrier, he can see the walls of Croque's room trembling.

units.displayText: The wall opposite him collapses, and a berserk agent barges in.

spans.text: The wall opposite him collapses, and a berserk agent barges in.

units.rawText: That is when Simo remembers that this is a temporary observation station and it is not built to be robust.
units.displayText: That is when Simo remembers that this is a temporary observation station and it is not built to be robust.

spans.text: That is when Simo remembers that this is a temporary observation station and it is not built to be robust.

units.rawText: <color=red>Ugh... Guh... Consume... *(&%*%</color>
units.displayText: Ugh... Guh... Consume... *(&%*%

spans.text: Ugh... Guh... Consume... *(&%*%

units.rawText: Croque!
units.displayText: Croque!

spans.text: Croque!

units.displayText: Simo's body is already in motion before he cries out.

spans.text: Simo's body is already in motion before he cries out.

units.displayText: He smashes through the quarantine barrier and plants himself in front of Croque's sickbed.

spans.text: He smashes through the quarantine barrier and plants himself in front of Croque's sickbed.

units.rawText: Whoosh!
units.displayText: Whoosh!

spans.text: Whoosh!

units.rawText: <color=red>Graaaawr...</color>
units.displayText: Graaaawr...

spans.text: Graaaawr...

units.displayText: Simo pins the berserk agent to the ground, but the business end of his crossbow wavers as he hesitates over whether or not to deal the fatal blow.

units.displayText: Ka-chak. Bang!

units.displayText: Received. Security personnel please report to Ward 4.

units.displayText: Repeat...

spans.text: Repeat...

units.rawText: ...Thank you.
units.displayText: ...Thank you.

spans.text: ...Thank you.

units.rawText: I have the feeling you could have taken care of that problem even without me around.
units.displayText: I have the feeling you could have taken care of that problem even without me around.

spans.text: I have the feeling you could have taken care of that problem even without me around.

units.rawText: But of course. It's me, after all. Come, go ahead and say, "I expected nothing less of you."
units.displayText: But of course. It's me, after all. Come, go ahead and say, "I expected nothing less of you."

spans.text: But of course. It's me, after all. Come, go ahead and say, "I expected nothing less of you."

units.rawText: Wha...?
units.displayText: Wha...?

spans.text: Wha...?

units.rawText: (Wheezes heavily) I was just kidding. If you weren't around, I'd probably have been taken out without ever regaining consciousness.
units.displayText: (Wheezes heavily) I was just kidding. If you weren't around, I'd probably have been taken out without ever regaining consciousness.

spans.text: (Wheezes heavily) I was just kidding. If you weren't around, I'd probably have been taken out without ever regaining consciousness.

units.rawText: ...No, you wouldn't have. You're amazing.
units.displayText: ...No, you wouldn't have. You're amazing.

spans.text: ...No, you wouldn't have. You're amazing.

units.rawText: ...I don't know what to say to that straight-faced compliment.
units.displayText: ...I don't know what to say to that straight-faced compliment.

spans.text: ...I don't know what to say to that straight-faced compliment.

units.displayText: Croque hands Simo a stick of Pocque.

units.rawText: Want one?
units.displayText: Want one?

spans.text: Want one?

units.rawText: ...No thanks, I don't eat these.
units.displayText: ...No thanks, I don't eat these.

spans.text: ...No thanks, I don't eat these.

units.rawText: Huh, I guess that part hasn't changed.
units.displayText: Huh, I guess that part hasn't changed.

spans.text: Huh, I guess that part hasn't changed.

units.rawText: Croque mutters to herself and takes the Pocque back before lying back down on her bed.
units.displayText: Croque mutters to herself and takes the Pocque back before lying back down on her bed.

spans.text: Croque mutters to herself and takes the Pocque back before lying back down on her bed.

units.rawText: I wanted to give you guidance like the Professor would, saying cool things while lecturing you in a serious tone despite being weak and bedridden.
units.displayText: I wanted to give you guidance like the Professor would, saying cool things while lecturing you in a serious tone despite being weak and bedridden.

spans.text: I wanted to give you guidance like the Professor would, saying cool things while lecturing you in a serious tone despite being weak and bedridden.

units.rawText: Then you'd awaken from your confusion, your eyes brimming with warm tears.
units.displayText: Then you'd awaken from your confusion, your eyes brimming with warm tears.

spans.text: Then you'd awaken from your confusion, your eyes brimming with warm tears.

units.rawText: But that would be totally out of character for me. I can only listen to my friends pour their heart out every now and then. Actually dispensing guidance would be too... (cough) too much... of a stretch.
units.displayText: But that would be totally out of character for me. I can only listen to my friends pour their heart out every now and then. Actually dispensing guidance would be too... (cough) too much... of a stretch.

spans.text: But that would be totally out of character for me. I can only listen to my friends pour their heart out every now and then. Actually dispensing guidance would be too... (cough) too much... of a stretch.

units.rawText: Are you alright!?
units.displayText: Are you alright!?

spans.text: Are you alright!?

units.rawText: Not really. I think I should rest.
units.displayText: Not really. I think I should rest.

spans.text: Not really. I think I should rest.

units.displayText: Simo opens his mouth to say something but changes his mind.

units.displayText: Then, as the medical personnel enter, Simo is ushered outside.

units.displayText: Just before he is out the door, Croque quietly whispers something.

spans.text: Just before he is out the door, Croque quietly whispers something.

units.rawText: <size=28>Thank you for coming to see me.</size>
units.displayText: Thank you for coming to see me.

spans.text: Thank you for coming to see me.

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: I leave the Oasis in your good hands.
units.displayText: I leave the Oasis in your good hands.

spans.text: I leave the Oasis in your good hands.

units.rawText: Tsk, the Professor made it sound so cool, so I've always wanted to say it just once.
units.displayText: Tsk, the Professor made it sound so cool, so I've always wanted to say it just once.

spans.text: Tsk, the Professor made it sound so cool, so I've always wanted to say it just once.

units.rawText: ...I'll take care of it, so relax and rest.
units.displayText: ...I'll take care of it, so relax and rest.

spans.text: ...I'll take care of it, so relax and rest.

units.displayText: The door closes, and Simo spaces out in the corridor.

spans.text: The door closes, and Simo spaces out in the corridor.

units.rawText: She's... leaving it to me?
units.displayText: She's... leaving it to me?

units.rawText: ...In any case, I'm starting to understand what I want to do and what I ought to do.
